reuse.why: Reuses ensureBankAccountNotLinked, findOrCreateBank and the Akahu link flow, and extracts a shared downloadSingleProviderTransactions for Akahu and Fintegra instead of copying the download.

duplication.why: No new copy of the link or download logic is written; both providers share one implementation of each.

placement.why: Pieces sit in the usual modules (accounts/app.ts, sync.ts, server-config, types), but the generic link flow is still hosted in a function named linkAkahuAccount.

scope.why: Mostly Fintegra plumbing; widening DbAccount.account_sync_source to list all existing providers is a small adjacent cleanup.

maintainability.why: Turning linkAkahuAccount into a provider-flagged function with provider === 'fintegra' branches for the bank key and synced tables plus a type cast makes it a special-cased hybrid; a neutral helper with explicit parameters would age better.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The Fintegra link and download go through the existing duplicate-link check and the shared Akahu/Fintegra functions.

disguised_duplication.where: None; downloadAkahuTransactions now delegates to the shared downloader.
